item.title: Trump-Appointed Judge Rules Against Him on Swing State’s Voter Rolls
item.description: A Trump-appointed judge blocked an attempt by the Department of Justice to seize the state of Michigan’s voter rolls Tuesday. U.S. District Court Judge Hala Jarbou ruled that federal law does not require Michigan to turn over voter registration lists or voters’ personal information, and dismissed the case. item.title: White House Insists Trump Threat to Canada Bridge Is “America First”
